info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Ride Status API provides real-time information on the status of rideshare rides. This API allows consumers to query the current status of specific rides, facilitating better tracking and management of rideshare services. It is typically used by application developers and service operators aiming to integrate rideshare functionalities into their platforms. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their applications, provide up-to-date ride information to end-users, and improve overall service efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of rides.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the latest status information for all rides. Use this operation to monitor ride availability, ongoing rides, and any updates related to ride status.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of rides. It should provide necessary parameters in JSON format to obtain the current status of the rides.

200.description: The request was successful, and the ride status is returned.

ListRideshareRidesStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to ride status. It is expected to be a string value indicating the desired input for the operation.
